account.label: Account
account.description: Your details, email address and password.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.description: GANIS theme and text size, applied to all your projects.

developer.label: Developer
developer.description: Create your own packages. To start with: themes, usable right away on this device.

saving.label: Saving
saving.description: Automatic or manual saving of your changes, on this device.

info.title: Account details
info.description: This information is stored locally, on this device.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Optional, used only as a local contact. Leave the field empty to remove it.
email.label: Email address
email.failed: Unable to change the email address.

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 8 characters, with one letter and one digit.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose the look of the interface.

light.label: Light
light.description: Light background, comfortable during the day.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Dark background, easy on the eyes at night.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Makes the whole interface larger or smaller.

preview.title: Preview
preview.text: Inspiration comes while writing: every project starts with a first sentence.

note.title: Saved on this device
note.text: These preferences never change the content of your projects.

colorTheme.title: Color theme
colorTheme.description: Palette used in both light and dark modes.

become.title: Become a developer
become.description: Developer mode adds creation tools to your account.

perks.create: Create theme plugins: light and dark colors, corner radius, live preview.
perks.direct: Your creations work right away, with no download or installation.
perks.share: Later: publish and share your packages with the community.

become.note: Your projects and preferences stay the same.
become.confirmText: Your account “{{username}}” will get the Developer role and access to package creation tools.

active.title: Developer mode is on
active.description: Your account has access to package creation tools.
active.roleAdmin: As an administrator, you already have every development tool.

tools.title: Create a plugin
tools.description: Choose the type of package to create.

theme.title: Theme plugin
theme.description: Light and dark mode colors, corner radius. Usable right away.

leave.title: Leave developer mode
leave.description: Your account goes back to being a regular user account.
leave.details: Creation tools and your themes will no longer be shown. Your themes aren't deleted: they'll come back if you turn developer mode on again.
leave.confirmText: Creation tools will be hidden. If one of your themes is in use, GANIS will switch back to the default theme. You can turn developer mode back on at any time.

autoSave.title: Auto save
autoSave.description: Choose whether GANIS saves your changes on its own or you save them yourself.
autoSave.on_one: On: saves {{count}} second after your last change.
autoSave.on_other: On: saves {{count}} seconds after your last change.
autoSave.off: Off: you save with the “Save” button.

delay.title: Delay before saving
delay.description: Time without a new change before GANIS saves.

note.title: Spotting unsaved work
note.dot: A dot instead of the close button marks an unsaved tab.
note.ask: Before closing such a tab, leaving the page or closing GANIS, you're asked whether to save, not save, or cancel.
